entry_points.text: Paging and debug flags are boot-controlled with debug adding warnings and dumps; weak protection hook returns input; setup initialises slot bases with once warning on reuse and leak check counts occupied.

Early and late initialisers converge on common executable setup; page fault injection exposes boot-parameter hook and debug filesystem with fault attribute, reclaim and high-memory toggles and minimum order; slab exposes boot hook and debug filesystem with fault attribute, reclaim and filter toggles.

Automatic scanner runs as named thread at lowered priority with optional first delay, looping scan under mutex then interruptible sleep until stopped; start is idempotent and warns on creation failure; stop clears existing thread; debug listing holds scan mutex and RCU across walk.

exports.text: DMA pool create validates inputs, links pool and publishes device file for first pool with rollback; destroy tolerates null, unlinks, removes file on last pool and leaks pages if busy; alloc pops, drops lock for coherent page then carves and records address; free validates pair.
Early mapping offers device, normal, read-only and raw-protection variants over one slot engine with matching unmaps and a chunked copy helper.

Executable allocator rounds size, uses cache when flagged else direct ranged vmalloc and clears tagging; read-write variant then promotes to writable; free tries cache reclaim then generic release and forbids interrupt context; status reports cache flag; restore sets read-only-executable; arch hook defaults absent for fallback.

Page fault injector excludes below minimum order, no-fail, and by default high-memory and reclaim allocations before delegating to generic logic sized by order with quiet handling when warnings suppressed.
Leak hooks for ordinary, per-cpu and vmalloc allocs and for partial free and trace refresh act only when enabled with valid pointer and delegate to tracking, partial delete and stack update.

hazards.text: Freeing unknown address reports bad DMA and freeing already-free block reports already free without changing pool; bytes differing from freed poison trigger corruption report with dump.
Late primitives abort, while slot exhaustion, allocation failure and oversize mapping only warn and return null.

invariants.text: Size is raised to header and rounded to alignment with zero as one; per-page area is max of block and page with boundary defaulting or capped; carving skips straddling boundaries and assigns increasing addresses; one build prefills freed marker and checks beyond header with dump; lookup finds first page containing address.

Slot alloc refuses late, needs free slot, rejects zero, wrapping or oversize ranges, aligns outward and installs one fixmap per page; unmap needs exact match then clears and frees; copy loops bounded chunks mapping and unmapping same span; boot keeps parallel address, length and base arrays; largest span is per-slot pages shifted.

Ranged allocation retries fallback, warns on failure and optionally builds shadow freeing on error, alternate build uses plain alloc; direct-map updates in page-order strides restoring prefix on failure; candidates must lie inside primary or fallback; no-cache build always misses; reclamation needs large-page alignment and forcing write clears execute first.

Freed extents coalesce with neighbours; allocation takes first large accepted extent with rollback on remainder failure; refill tries huge then exact, prefills traps, promotes protection and atomically adds plus carves with restore on failure; hits avoid vmalloc; pending-free is tag bit; reclaim cycles writable, traps and protection before moving to free.

Validation needs non-zero default alignment, bounds and protection else rejects, stripping cache flags when unsupported; missing types inherit defaults with module data forced to kernel protection; init prefers arch ranges else vmalloc-spanning executable default then validates, fills and publishes.

White is below minimum, gray at or above; unreferenced needs white, allocated and aged; only white counts refs and queues gray on threshold; pointer scan strips tags, bounds-checks and ignores misses and self links while forwarding excess; hex refuses physical and truncates; scan-area validates bounds; stackless or dedup-failed records print immediately.

locks.text: Destroy unlinks under two mutexes with file removal after dropping inner mutex; per-pool spinlock with saved interrupts covers counters and is dropped across sleeping coherent allocation.
One mutex serialises busy and free trees and pending count, statically initialised with trees bound as external lock, held across reclaim scan and across refill add-plus-carve to keep them atomic.

Per-object spinlock with saved interrupts covers flags, counts, hashes and scan list with reference held and nested level when scanning; scan mutex spans whole scans and dedup; yielding retains reference, marks undeletable, drops lock to yield then rejoins.

state_machines.text: Block is free while linked from head, active after pop with count increment, free again only after validation with decrement; managed pool is unregistered until holder attach, reachable by matching and destroyed once on explicit or teardown release.

Busy extents whose immediate reclaim fails are tag-marked and counted with delayed retry; background handler clears tags and retries, rescheduling while any remain else scheduling cleanup, while immediate success schedules cleanup directly.

Full pass whitens, resets suspects, blackens out-of-range physical, seeds gray queue, scans per-cpu, zone pages under online-mem hold and optionally stacks in bounded chunks, drains gray, re-queues changed white, flags remaining as suspects and drains again; reporting runs collect then confirm, promotes aged suspects to reported with deduped output and sets found flag.

structs.text: Block carries address and next link and page carries virtual and device bases; test pairs address with pointer and triples size, alignment and boundary; each case repeats one hundred times.

Executable cache holds mutex, busy and free trees and pending count; range pointers hold active and default info as read-only after init; deferred delay is ten milliseconds in ticks; pending marker is bit page-shift minus one; log lines carry fixed subsystem prefix.

Leak record holds lock, linkage, counts, pointer, size, checksum, stack, scan list, time and task; scan-area holds start and length with empty meaning whole; status occupies low bits zero to six for allocated, reported, no-scan, full-scan, physical, per-cpu and suspect; deletion uses removed and no-delete; gray is zero and black minus one.

Page control groups fault attribute with exemptions and minimum order defaulting on and threshold one, never faulting below minimum, for no-fail or by default for high-memory and reclaim; slab groups fault attribute with exemption and filter defaulting on and off; scan uses depth sixteen, age five seconds, first sixty seconds, interval six hundred seconds, block four thousand ninety-six and native stride; hex uses four-space prefix, sixteen-byte rows and at most two lines.
